title: Michiru Plushy Mod(BNA)
description: This mod adds Michiru Kagemori as plushy from BNA(Brand New Animal)
body: The purpose of this mod is to add a plush version of the character Michiru Kagemori to the game Minecraft; it is intended for decorative purposes.The character on the plush toy I made does not belong to me; it belongs to an anime called *Brand New Animal*, produced by Studio Trigger.(IMPORTANT:FOR RECIPE LOOK THE GALLERY)Models made by me and code stuff helped by Mrachi
